documents.title: FDA Prescribing Information: Metformin Hydrochloride
documents.text: Metformin decreases hepatic glucose production, decreases intestinal absorption of glucose, and improves insulin sensitivity by increasing peripheral glucose uptake and utilization.

documents.title: ACCP Clinical Practice Guideline: Antithrombotic Therapy
documents.text: Co-administration of warfarin and aspirin significantly increases the risk of major gastrointestinal and intracranial bleeding. Combination therapy requires close INR monitoring and risk-benefit evaluation.

documents.title: FDA Safety Alert: Haloperidol and Azithromycin Co-administration
documents.text: Combining haloperidol with azithromycin causes additive QTc interval prolongation, increasing the risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias including Torsades de Pointes.

documents.title: FDA Black Box Warning: Spironolactone Hyperkalemia Risk
documents.text: Spironolactone can cause severe hyperkalemia, which can lead to cardiac arrhythmias and sudden death. Concomitant administration with potassium supplements or potassium-sparing diuretics is strictly contraindicated.

documents.title: FDA Prescribing Information: Atorvastatin Calcium
documents.text: Atorvastatin (a statin) and aspirin are frequently co-administered for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. No clinically significant pharmacokinetic drug-drug interactions have been observed when atorvastatin is co-administered with aspirin.
